robotcompR: robotics, kinematics, dynamics and motion planning in R

Source: R/robotcompR-package.R
robotcompR-package.Rd

robotcompR provides spatial mathematics on SO(2), SO(3), SE(2) and SE(3), rigid-body tree robot models, Denavit-Hartenberg and URDF model construction, forward and inverse kinematics, Jacobians, rigid-body dynamics, collision checking, motion planning, trajectory generation and mobile robotics.

Details

Conventions used throughout the package:

  • Units are SI: meters, radians, seconds, kilograms, newtons.

  • Rotations are active and right-handed. A pose \({}^{a}T_{b}\) is the pose of frame b in frame a and maps b coordinates to a coordinates.

  • Quaternions are scalar-first c(w, x, y, z) with the Hamilton product.

  • Twists, Jacobian rows and spatial vectors are ordered linear first, c(v, w).

  • Euler angles are intrinsic; "ZYX" gives yaw, pitch, roll.

See vignette("conventions", package = "robotcompR") for details.

The package is research and teaching software. It is not certified for industrial, medical, automotive or any other safety-critical use, and it never sends commands to physical hardware.
